notes: Raven edge NPZ from Edge V1-V7: velw = peak amplitude of the strongest partial within +-0.25 % of each mode, ^0.8; band envelopes in the plugin's 22 one-third-octave bands, 20 ms frames from the strike, divided per band by the velw norm so each band follows the SPEAR band level; smoothed (30 ms) after 200 ms; extended past each capture by its late decay.
